Name: Fucking Machine - Unofficial 1.6 update
Author: sumaniBlack
Description:
This is an unofficial update of the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10812]Fucking Machine[/url] by simezi21, who okayed inofficial updates of their mods - if you like this mod go over there and endorse it.
[size=4]
[b]This mod will be available until simezi21 either tells me to take it down or updates the original mod.[/b][/size]

The mod will add 12 craftable machines and 4 new items. For animated images go to the original mod and take a look.
If you use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22796]Dark Club[/url] this mod is unnecessary, as it is integrated into the other mod and the items and machines will conflict. They use the same identifiers, so it's no problem to switch between the two, although there was an issue with items from one not stacking with the other despite being the same item.

Updating to this mod from the original will break your items and may break your machines. You will have no choice but to delete everything not recognized anymore and start from scratch.

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
1.Download and extract this mod and the required Mods.
2.Put the extracted Mods into the \Stardew Valley\mods\ folder.
3.Launch the game and enjoy.
